named_premises: The soul field is modeled by a real scalar field on a finite 1+1 dimensional spacetime lattice with interior indices t,x in {1,2}.
The field is a stationary point of the discrete Klein-Gordon action S = sum [1/2(Δ_t Ψ)^2 - 1/2(Δ_x Ψ)^2 - 1/2 m_S^2 Ψ^2], so its Euler-Lagrange derivative at each interior point vanishes.
m_S^2 is represented by a real mass-squared parameter m2.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Finite-difference derivation of the soul-field Klein-Gordon equation from the discrete scalar-field action.

obstructions.reason: The derivation fails at the move from P-IMAGO's analogical order/intelligibility of created consciousness to a specific field ontology and the Klein-Gordon equation. A0+P-IMAGO do not decide any physical equation, field type, mass parameter, coupling, or empirical prediction.
